content.text:
This PR added

    {.key = "value_form", .elem_type = GKYL_MP_STRING, .cval = "nodal"},
To a few arrays that are nodal arrays in gyrokinetics. Please add the associated
    {.key = "value_form", .elem_type = GKYL_MP_STRING, .cval = "modal"},
Or 
    {.key = "value_form", .elem_type = GKYL_MP_STRING, .cval = "quad"},
to all saved arrays so they contain the relevant metadata.
One piece of feedback recieved: i think if you are going to add this now, you should add "modal" to all other corresponding files. I think, but i'm not sure, you mainly need to add it to the "io_meta_dg" metadata at the app and species levels.

I’ll trace the array-writing metadata and add the appropriate `modal` or `quad` value. I’ll use the repository’s directory, code-style, naming, software-design, gyrokinetic, and verification skills for this change.
